---
title: "GAM: curves by body size"
output: html_document
---

Purpose: prevalence and load curves over SVL (with the metamorph baseline) from the GAM fits of
`06_gam_modeling.qmd`, for a qualitative read of the species in the discussion. Replaces
`size_bd_gam/03_size_bd_GAM_analysis.Rmd` (m3 fits; kept until retired).

Reading the curves:

- each curve is for an average site, site-year and event (`re_formula = NA`): the population
  average of the species, not a particular site
- prevalence is 1 - hu; load is mu, the mean log load density among positives
- bands are 50% and 95% intervals of the posterior; the dashed line is the subadult / adult
  SVL cutoff of stage 1
- how much to read into a curve follows its stage 1 contrast: see `06_gam_species.csv` (tier,
  co-sampled events, time-segregated flag, stage 1 support). Across the stage boundary, a
  time-segregated species' curve partly reflects when each size class was swabbed, as its
  stage 1 contrast does

```{r}
#| output: false
librarian::shelf(tidyverse, here, brms, tidybayes, patchwork, arrow)

intermediates_dir = here("size_bd_contrast", "intermediates")
models_dir = here("size_bd_contrast", "models")
figures_dir = here("size_bd_contrast", "figures")
```

# Load fits

```{r}
# species table (06): stage 1 counts, tiers, flags, svl cutoffs
gam_species_table = read_csv(file.path(intermediates_dir, "06_gam_species.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# the data each model was fit to (06; GAM data + event ids). from here rather than fit$data,
# which holds only the model's own columns (no life_stage_simple)
gam_data = readRDS(file.path(intermediates_dir, "06_gam_model_data.rds"))

gam_species = sort(gam_species_table$taxon_capture)

gam_fits = set_names(gam_species) %>%
  map(~ readRDS(file.path(models_dir, paste0("gam_m4_", .x, ".rds"))))
```

# Curves

```{r}
# posterior curves for one species and one part.
#   part = "hu": prevalence (1 - hu); part = "mu": mean log load among positives
# metamorph baseline: a single prediction (svl does not enter, the by-smooth is off), when the
# species has metamorphs (for load: positive metamorphs). post-metamorph curve: 200 points over
# the subadult / adult svl range the smooth was fit on.
svl_curve = function(sp, part) {
  fit = gam_fits[[sp]]
  sp_data = filter(gam_data, taxon_capture == sp)
  value = if (part == "hu") "prevalence" else "mu"
  to_value = function(d) if (part == "hu") mutate(d, prevalence = 1 - hu) else d

  # median and 50 / 95% intervals per svl value, as columns <value>, <value>_0.5_lower, ...
  summarise_curve = function(draws, is_met) {
    draws %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      to_value() %>%
      mutate(v = .data[[value]]) %>%
      group_by(svl_mm) %>%
      median_qi(v, .width = c(0.5, 0.95)) %>%
      pivot_wider(id_cols = c(svl_mm, v), names_from = .width, values_from = c(.lower, .upper)) %>%
      rename_with(~ sub("^\\.(lower|upper)_(.*)$", paste0(value, "_\\2_\\1"), .x)) %>%
      rename(!!value := v) %>%
      mutate(is_metamorph = is_met)
  }

  met_data = filter(sp_data, life_stage_simple == "metamorph")
  if (part == "mu") met_data = filter(met_data, bd_load_co100_density > 0)

  # svl is a placeholder for metamorphs (the smooth is off); the same value in the prevalence and
  # load rows so the two join into one metamorph row per species
  svl_met = mean(sp_data$svl_mm)
  met = if (nrow(met_data) > 0) {
    tibble(svl_mm = svl_met, is_not_metamorph = 0) %>%
      add_epred_draws(fit, dpar = part, re_formula = NA) %>%
      summarise_curve(is_met = 1)
  } else {
    tibble(svl_mm = svl_met, is_metamorph = 1)   # empty metamorph panel
  }

  svl_post = sp_data$svl_mm[sp_data$life_stage_simple != "metamorph"]
  post = tibble(svl_mm = seq(min(svl_post), max(svl_post), length.out = 200),
                is_not_metamorph = 1) %>%
    add_epred_draws(fit, dpar = part, re_formula = NA) %>%
    summarise_curve(is_met = 0)

  bind_rows(met, post) %>%
    mutate(taxon_capture = sp)
}

prev_curves = map(gam_species, svl_curve, part = "hu") %>% list_rbind()
load_curves = map(gam_species, svl_curve, part = "mu") %>% list_rbind()

# one table, same columns as the earlier GAM export (GAM_03_a): prevalence_* and mu_* with
# _0.5_lower / _0.95_upper etc., plus is_metamorph, svl_mm, svl_mm_cutoff
svl_agg_all = full_join(prev_curves, load_curves,
                        by = c("taxon_capture", "is_metamorph", "svl_mm")) %>%
  left_join(select(gam_species_table, taxon_capture, svl_mm_cutoff = svl_cutoff_mm),
            by = "taxon_capture") %>%
  select(taxon_capture, is_metamorph, svl_mm, svl_mm_cutoff, everything())
```

# Figures

```{r}
#| fig-height: 28
#| fig-width: 8
# species shown: all fitted species by default. to choose a subset for the discussion, set
# show_species to their taxon_capture values (06_gam_species.csv says what each curve rests on)
show_species = gam_species

# panel label: species, then stage 1 tier (prevalence / load) and the time-segregated flag
species_labels = gam_species_table %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(str_to_sentence(gsub("_", " ", taxon_capture)), "\n",
                        "tier ", tier_hu, " / ", tier_mu,
                        if_else(flag_time_segregated, ", time-seg.", ""))) %>%
  select(taxon_capture, label) %>%
  deframe()

# one row per species: metamorph box (left) + post-metamorph curve (right), shared y range
svl_rows = function(svl_agg, value, fill, y_range) {
  map(sort(unique(svl_agg$taxon_capture)), function(sp) {
    d = filter(svl_agg, taxon_capture == sp)
    col = function(x) paste0(value, "_", x)

    p_met = ggplot(filter(d, is_metamorph == 1),
                   aes(x = "metamorph", middle = .data[[value]],
                       lower = .data[[col("0.5_lower")]], upper = .data[[col("0.5_upper")]],
                       ymin = .data[[col("0.95_lower")]], ymax = .data[[col("0.95_upper")]])) +
      geom_boxplot(stat = "identity", fill = fill, alpha = 0.72, outlier.shape = NA) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = y_range) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = species_labels[[sp]]) +
      theme_classic()

    p_post = ggplot(filter(d, is_metamorph == 0), aes(x = svl_mm, y = .data[[value]])) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .data[[col("0.5_lower")]], ymax = .data[[col("0.5_upper")]]),
                  fill = fill, alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .data[[col("0.95_lower")]], ymax = .data[[col("0.95_upper")]]),
                  fill = fill, alpha = 0.3) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
      { if (!is.na(d$svl_mm_cutoff[1]))
          geom_vline(xintercept = d$svl_mm_cutoff[1], linetype = "dashed", color = "#666") } +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = y_range) +
      labs(x = "SVL (mm)", y = NULL) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
            axis.line.y = element_blank())

    p_met + p_post + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 3))
  })
}

shown = filter(svl_agg_all, taxon_capture %in% show_species)

# prevalence on its full 95% range; load on the 50% range of the post-metamorph curves (95%
# bands of thin species would otherwise flatten the rest)
prev_range = range(c(shown$prevalence_0.95_lower, shown$prevalence_0.95_upper), na.rm = TRUE)
load_range = shown %>%
  filter(is_metamorph == 0) %>%
  with(range(c(mu_0.5_lower, mu_0.5_upper), na.rm = TRUE))

p_prev = wrap_plots(svl_rows(shown, "prevalence", "#8DA0CB", prev_range), ncol = 1) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Bd prevalence by body size")
p_load = wrap_plots(svl_rows(shown, "mu", "#FC8D62", load_range), ncol = 1) +
  plot_annotation(title = "log Bd load (among positives) by body size")

n_shown = length(show_species)
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "07_gam_svl_prevalence.png"), p_prev, width = 8, height = n_shown * 2)
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "07_gam_svl_load.png"), p_load, width = 8, height = n_shown * 2)

p_prev
p_load
```

# Manuscript exports

```{r}
#| eval: false
# manuscript inputs, to replace GAM_03_a / GAM_03_b (build_intermediates.Rmd reads those names;
# re-point it when these are enabled). off until the fits are reviewed.
repo_dir = gsub("size_bd_load_analysis", "", here())
manuscript_data_dir = paste0(repo_dir, "size-bd-dynamics-manuscript/resources/01_essential_data/")

write_parquet(svl_agg_all, paste0(manuscript_data_dir, "contrast_07_a_gam_svl.parquet"))

# sample-level data the models were fit to (seasonal size-structure / cohort plots)
stopifnot(nrow(gam_data) == sum(map_int(gam_fits, ~ nrow(.x$data))))
write_parquet(gam_data, paste0(manuscript_data_dir, "contrast_07_b_gam_model_data.parquet"))
```
